translationRepairs: Soon afterward he was promoted to Grand Minister of Agriculture and made head of the Imperial Wardrobe Office, given the nominal title of chancellor while acting as Grand Minister of Revenue and supervising the Imperial Medical Office, with the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness bearing the golden seal and purple ribbon.

Soon afterward he was further appointed Grand Minister of Education and commissioner of the Imperial Wardrobe Office, given the nominal title of chancellor, acting as Grand Minister of Agriculture and supervising the Imperial Medical Office, with the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness bearing the golden seal and purple ribbon.

s0020 lists 加大司徒 then 行大司農 as separate offices; the before text wrongly makes both agriculture and mislabels 大司農 as Revenue. The proposed idiomatic correctly distinguishes Grand Minister of Education from acting Grand Minister of Agriculture.

Shortly he was further appointed Grand Minister of Agriculture, Commissioner of the Imperial Wardrobe Office, given the title of Chancellor at a distance, acting as Grand Minister of Revenue, and overseeing the Imperial Medical Office, with rank as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

Shortly he was further appointed Grand Minister of Education, Commissioner of the Imperial Wardrobe Office, given the title of Chancellor at a distance, acting as Grand Minister of Agriculture, and overseeing the Imperial Medical Office, with rank as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
The literal field has the same swap: 大司徒 rendered as Agriculture and 大司農 as Revenue. The proposed text correctly maps 大司徒 to Education and 行大司農 to acting Grand Minister of Agriculture.
